scoring_justification: Recomputing epsilon and corrugation from raw simulation curves is infeasible because the reference oracle does not produce the required CSV files; result-level comparison against paper-reported gold is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported gold values for epsilon and corrugation energy with tolerances.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper (The Journal of Physical Chemistry A, doi:10.1021/jp076122w) reports 'intermolecular potential of 0.10 ± 0.03 eV' and 'corrugation energy of 0.3 ± 0.1 eV'.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's abstract and conclusion.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own headline quantities and are used as the hidden gold reference.

outputs.description: To-be-reproduced lateral intermolecular potential ε (in eV) and corrugation energy E_c (in eV) for dodecane on Au(111).

output_contract.notes: The two energies are expected in eV. The checker compares them to hidden gold values within tolerances to account for stochastic run-to-run spread.

steps.description: Check that epsilon_eV and corrugation_eV are within tolerance of paper-reported values.
